text_clean: I bought these with high hopes of not having to dig my fingers to the back of my mouth to remove my aligners. Those were false hopes unfortunately. These things do not latch onto the aligners at all, and when they do they don't hold tight enough to remove anything. I ended up using my fingers anyway. And of course, by the time you figure out they don't work you've had them in your mouth and cannot return...so for your own benefit I say..DO NOT BUY. Just use your fingers....these things are just a pointless gimmick (and way too expensive for the tiny pieces of plastic they are anyway).

Do not know how many people have worked with this kind of material before (the plastic beads, and forming a tooth from it), BUT IF YOU HAVE, do NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT. There is another product on Amazon with almost the exact same name, that actually WORKS! SADLY AND SUPER FRUSTERATINGLY, THIS PRODUCT DOES NOT GET REALLY SOFT AND PLIABLE LIKE THE OTHER PRODUCT. No matter how hot I got the water to make it clear and easy to use, this product BARELY GETS CLEAR AND EVEN WHEN IT IS, IT IS STILL STIFF AND COOLS WAY TOO FAST!! IF YOU have used the other product it gets super soft and easy to mold. This stuff will not even give you time to mold the tooth, and will not stay in your mouth while molding it!! It immediately gets cold before you can even work with it and falls right out!! Here I assumed that these plastic beads were all the same and after now waiting for 4 days I still cannot fix my tooth!!!! Never again!!
